title: The Mock Exam and the Electric Zing — Part 1

series.summary: When high school midterm exam results are posted, Rentaro celebrates alongside Hakari, Karane, and Shizuka until top-ranked prodigy Nano Eiai passes by. A sudden lock of eyes triggers a blinding Zing shock, revealing Nano as Rentaro’s fourth destined soulmate.

segments.voiceover_text: When midterm exam rankings drop outside the high school, Rentaro celebrates his score alongside Hakari, Karane, and sweet Shizuka.
Suddenly, top-ranked prodigy Nano Eiai strides past the crowd, showing total indifference toward her spotless, perfect mock exam score.
As their eyes instantly meet, a violent electric shockwave freezes time, signaling Rentaro’s fourth destined soulmate has finally arrived.
Nano clutches her racing chest in sudden bewilderment before coldly departing, clearly unnerved by this bizarre, illogical emotional disturbance.
Rentaro stands completely paralyzed in utter disbelief, realizing his next destined girlfriend is a ruthlessly detached, living analytical machine.
